name: Flex4DHuman
description: Flex4DHuman is a generative framework from University of Washington, Zhejiang University, and Tencent for flexible multi-view video diffusion and 4D human reconstruction from monocular or sparse video streams without explicit geometry priors.
keyFeatures: Pose-Conditioned Video Diffusion: Synthesizes synchronized dense multi-view videos from monocular or sparse video inputs using relative SE(3) camera poses without explicit geometry priors
Wan 2.1 1.3B Backbone: Fine-tuned on the Wan 2.1 1.3B text-to-video foundation model to leverage strong temporal and structural priors
5-Axis Spatio-Temporal RoPE: Extended rotary positional embedding incorporating spatial dimensions, time, view indices, and camera geometry for spatial-aware cross-view attention
Curriculum Training Scheme: Multi-stage training progression including pose following, reference-to-target view generation, and temporal rollout
Direct 4D Gaussian Splatting Integration: Outputs synchronized multi-view videos engineered for seamless 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) reconstruction
curatorNotes: Verified academic research collaboration between University of Washington, Zhejiang University, and Tencent. Paper on arXiv (arXiv:2606.13655) with GitHub repository and Hugging Face dataset.
institution: University of Washington, Zhejiang University, Tencent
